## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks performed and any untested behavior. Documentation-only changes
need command/link review; runtime changes need evidence on the target hardware.

For performance changes, include the before/after request shapes, prompt/output
counts, warmup/cache state, repeats, throughput, and full-context memory behavior.
For precision or state changes, include correctness/quality evidence.
